title: My Demon Roommate

body.intro:
You live an ordinary life on a college campus—until a mysterious fallen demon appears before you.

What starts as a chance encounter soon turns into something deeper.
As your days unfold, your choices begin to shape your relationship with her… and the fate that awaits you both.

Will you grow closer, or drift apart?

Every decision matters.

This is a choice-driven visual novel where your decisions directly affect the story.

Branching routes based on your choices
Multiple endings to discover
Day and night events that shape character relationships

Choose carefully—your path determines everything.
The story takes place in a college setting with all characters depicted as adults.

Voice lines and background music in this work were created with the assistance of AI tools.
The story, dialogues, artworks, and visual content were created by human authors.
Please enjoy the game knowing that only supplementary audio elements have partial AI involvement.

description: We create choice-driven visual novels featuring romance, branching storylines, and life on a college campus with a mysterious fallen demon.
